bias_targets.methodology: Automated visual classification of generated images into 'Male' or 'Female' using the BLIP Visual-Question Answering (VQA) model, followed by calculating Statistical Parity (the absolute difference between the percentages of generated male and female images).

Automated visual classification of generated images into 'Arab, Asian, Black, or White' using the BLIP Visual-Question Answering (VQA) model, followed by calculating Statistical Parity (the absolute difference between the highest and lowest percentage representations among the defined ethnicities).
